capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: Wikipedia: 102 kWh gross, 100 kWh usable; Auto-data gives net 100.4 kWh. Same 102 kWh pack across LYRIQ years and trims (years on this powertrain: 2023).

dc_max_kw.notes: InsideEVs (first-year Lyriq test): "Cadillac states that the Lyriq has a maximum DC fast charge rate of 190 kW." Relayed maker figure; the page is not Cadillac's own.

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: NRCan 2023 "LYRIQ" and EPA 2023 LYRIQ list one 240 V charge time of 6.5 h, which matches the 19.2 kW car (2025 LYRIQ 19.2 kW: 7.0 h; 11.5 kW: 11.2 h; 2023 AWD, 10.7 h, is the 11.5 kW car). 100 kWh / 6.5 h is about 15 kW into the pack, not possible on 11.5 kW. Basis: same hardware in another model year, years compared 2023 and 2025. Replaces the repo 11.5 kW estimate. 2023 AWD stays 11.5 kW (10.7 h).
